"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Infrastructure programs have traditionally been non-partisan.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration has replaced civil engineering with social engineering as it pursues an exclusively urban vision of dense housing and government transit.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Less than six percent of the funds in the vaunted stimulus package went to transportation, with most of that to cosmetic \"shovel-ready\" projects rather than fundamental structural improvements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Davis-Bacon law drives up infrastructure construction and maintenance costs for the benefit of that party's union stalwarts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The safety and availability of the American water supply is in perilous condition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Engineering surveys report crumbling drinking water systems, aging dams, and overwhelmed wastewater infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Investment in water infrastructure, as well as with levees and inland waterways, can renew communities, attract businesses, and create jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Investment in water infrastructure can assure the health and safety of the American people.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The nation's ports have become a bottleneck in international trade.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"America's exporters sometimes use Canadian ports in order to reach the world market in a timely manner.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"With the widening of the Panama Canal, East Coast and Gulf ports have an extraordinary opportunity to boost container traffic but require major improvement to remain competitive receivers of large vessels.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
